subsections.content: Machinery HOF GmbH ("Company," "we," "us," or "our") is committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring you have a positive experience on our website machineryhofgmbh.com ("Website"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our Website and use our services.
This Privacy Policy complies with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applies to all personal data processing activities conducted by Machinery HOF GmbH.
Please read this Privacy Policy carefully. If you do not agree with our policies and practices, please do not use our Website.
The data controller responsible for your personal data is:
We collect information in the following ways:

categories.name: Information You Provide Directly
items: Contact forms and inquiry submissions (name, email, phone, company, message)
Email communications with our sales team

categories.name: Information Collected Automatically
items: Pages visited and time spent on the Website
Referral source (how you found our Website)

subsections.content: We do not intentionally collect personal data from children under 16 years of age. If we become aware that such data has been collected, we will delete it promptly.
We process personal data on the following legal bases under GDPR:
list: Consent: Processing where you have given explicit consent
Contract: Processing necessary to perform our contractual obligations
Legal Obligation: Processing required by applicable laws and regulations
Legitimate Interests: Processing necessary for our business purposes (customer service, marketing, fraud prevention)

subsections.content: We use the information we collect for the following purposes:
list: Processing and fulfilling your orders and inquiries
Providing customer support and technical assistance
Sending product updates, newsletters, and promotional materials (with your consent)
Improving our Website functionality and user experience
Analyzing website usage and user behavior through analytics
Detecting and preventing fraud or security breaches
Complying with legal obligations and industry regulations

subsections.content: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal data to third parties. We may share your information only in the following circumstances:
list: Service Providers: Trusted third parties who assist us in operating our Website and providing services
Legal Requirements: When required by law or in response to legal process
Business Transfers: In the event of merger, acquisition, or sale of assets
Your Consent: When you explicitly authorize us to share your data

subsections.content: All service providers are bound by data processing agreements and are required to maintain the confidentiality and security of your personal data.
We retain personal data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes for which it was collected, or as required by law:

retention.duration: Up to 3 years after last contact unless ongoing relationship exists

subsections.content: When data is no longer needed, we securely delete or anonymize it.
We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction, including:
list: Secure firewalls and intrusion detection systems
Regular security audits and vulnerability assessments
Access controls and employee confidentiality agreements

subsections.content: While we strive to protect your personal data, no method of transmission over the internet is completely secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.
You have the following rights regarding your personal data:

rights.name: Right of Access
rights.description: You may request a copy of your personal data we hold

rights.name: Right to Rectification
rights.description: You may request corrections to inaccurate data

rights.name: Right to Erasure
rights.description: You may request deletion of your personal data ("right to be forgotten")

rights.name: Right to Restrict Processing
rights.description: You may request limitation of data processing

rights.name: Right to Data Portability
rights.description: You may request your data in a structured, commonly used format

rights.name: Right to Object
rights.description: You may object to processing for marketing purposes

rights.name: Right to Withdraw Consent
rights.description: You may withdraw consent at any time

subsections.content: To exercise any of these rights, please contact us at islam@machinery-hof.com with your request. We will respond within 30 days.
We use cookies and similar technologies to enhance your experience. Please refer to our Cookie Policy for detailed information about which cookies we use and how you can manage them.

Our Website may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of these third-party sites. We recommend reviewing their privacy policies before providing personal data.

Your personal data is primarily processed and stored in the European Union. If data is transferred outside the EU/EEA, we ensure appropriate safeguards are in place, such as Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) or Binding Corporate Rules (BCRs).
